title: Settlement Basis for an Approved Refund on a Vacation Package
content:
An approved refund on any of the Vacation Package Products settles in the form the product prescribes: money to the card, or a future travel credit voucher, never both and never a mixture.

## When a payout line may be raised

A payout line is raised only while the package record stands at cancelled or completed. The state relied on is the one the package record shows for the package being refunded, correlated by that package's own reference; it is the record, and not the party's account of where the holiday stands, that answers this test. A package still standing at quoted, deposit held, confirmed, travelling or closed admits no payout line.

## Time the settlement takes

The settlement takes the product's processing time, counted in business days from the day the refund was approved, excluding weekends and public holidays in the lead traveller's country of residence.

## How payouts are raised against the money collected

Each payout is raised against the original ledger line it reverses, so a package with a deposit and several instalments settles as several payouts.

A payout may never exceed the amount that original line actually collected, and the sum of a package's payouts may never exceed the amount paid on it.

*Worked on hypothetical figures.* Suppose a package collected a deposit of 300.00 USD and two instalments of 450.00 USD each, and a refund of the whole amount is approved. It settles as three payouts, one against each of those three lines. No payout against the deposit line may exceed 300.00 USD, no payout against either instalment line may exceed 450.00 USD, and the three together may not exceed 1200.00 USD, being the amount paid on the package.

## Supplier failure

Where a supplier within the package fails financially, the protected amount is settled under the product's financial protection whatever its ordinary refund form.
